system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

ISSUES:
- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
The Seller’s “[STANDARD]” and “FINAL” labels, and its assertion that terms were agreed, are not evidence of Buyer approval. The review below treats the AUD 24 million debt-free/cash-free price as the baseline. Only summaries and disclosure extracts were supplied, so the SPA wording and underlying DD documents should be checked before mark-up.

| Issue | Seller’s position | What Buyer should want | Recommendation — one-line reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| **SPA-N-001 General liability cap** | General warranty liability capped at **20% / AUD 4.8m**. | Open at **100% of price**, with any negotiated general cap materially above 20%; preserve separate treatment for other claims. | **Reject 20%**: it may leave Buyer bearing substantial undisclosed loss despite paying AUD 24m. |
| **SPA-N-002 De minimis & basket** | AUD 25,000 per claim; AUD 250,000 **deductible** basket. | Lower thresholds (for example AUD 10,000 and AUD 100,000), aggregate related claims, and a **tipping** basket recoverable from dollar one. | **Counter**: the proposed thresholds could exclude numerous genuine losses. |
| **SPA-N-003 General claims time limit** | Notice within 18 months; limitations presumptively apply to every Claim. | At least **24–36 months** for general warranties; timely notified claims survive until resolved; distinct periods for tax, title and indemnities. | **Reject the blanket rule**: latent problems may emerge after 18 months. |
| **SPA-N-004 Fundamental/Title regime** | Capacity and title warranties share the general cap and time limit. | Separate fundamental warranties with a **100% price cap** and a long period (for example six years), covering authority, ownership and unencumbered transfer. | **Reject**: Buyer must receive all shares it is paying for. |
| **SPA-N-005 Fraud carve-out** | “All Claims” limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance language could capture fraud; no express carve-out is identified. | Expressly exclude fraud, fraudulent concealment and intentional misrepresentation from caps, thresholds, time bars, disclosure, knowledge, exclusive remedy and non-reliance provisions. | **Insert an overriding carve-out**: Seller must not contractually shield deliberate dishonesty. |
| **SPA-N-006 Disclosure scope** | Blanket disclosure of the data room, accounts, registers and public records. | Only **specific, fair disclosure** identifying the nature and likely impact of a matter against the relevant warranty; no deemed disclosure by mere availability. | **Reject general disclosure**: Buyer should not have to infer exceptions from a document dump. |
| **SPA-N-007 Buyer knowledge qualifier** | Claims barred by Buyer/adviser knowledge, including matters discoverable in records. | Prefer **no knowledge exclusion**; at minimum, limit it to named Buyer individuals’ actual, conscious knowledge of specifically disclosed facts, with no adviser or constructive imputation. | **Delete or narrow**: “discoverable” knowledge transfers diligence risk to Buyer. |
| **SPA-N-008 Bluefen consent** | Reasonable endeavours; consent satisfied on delivery of a written consent, although DD-002 clause 11.3 conditions are not evidenced as satisfied. | A Buyer-benefit **condition precedent** requiring effective written consent and satisfaction or waiver of all associated conditions before Completion, on terms acceptable to Buyer. | **Do not complete on an incomplete consent**: Bluefen represents about 30% of FY26 revenue. |
| **SPA-N-009 Riverlark facility** | Approximately AUD 3.2m outstanding; security release after Completion. | Seller-funded repayment at or before Completion through controlled funds flow, with payout letter, effective releases and discharge deliverables; account for the debt once in price mechanics. | **Reject post-Completion release**: Buyer should not inherit debt or encumbered shares/assets. |
| **SPA-N-010 Employee bonuses** | AUD 420,000 conditional Completion bonuses omitted from funds flow; on-costs unclear. | Seller to fund them or deduct the full amount **plus applicable on-costs** from price as debt-like items, without double counting working capital. | **Fix funds flow**: Completion-triggered costs should not silently reduce Buyer’s value. |
| **SPA-N-011 Ironquay IP indemnity** | Indemnity limited to the SOW3 payment; AUD 180,000 appears open, with no payment receipt or confirmatory assignment. | Payment and documented vesting/assignment before Completion, plus a specific indemnity for resulting ownership, use, infringement and remediation losses outside general warranty limits. | **Expand protection**: paying the invoice alone may not cure defective IP title. |
| **SPA-N-012 Export/privacy incident** | Preliminary matter, not expected material; access, scope and notification need remain unknown. | Complete investigation and remediation before Completion, evidence of access/scope and legal assessment, required notifications if triggered, and a specific indemnity or escrow for pre-Completion losses. | **Keep open**: uncertainty is not proof of immateriality or non-notifiability. |
| **SPA-N-013 Sandbar renewals** | Three AUD 110,000 renewals treated as ordinary-course costs. | Verify timing, termination and accrual; disclose full terms; prohibit new commitments without Buyer consent and allocate pre-Completion liabilities through price/working capital mechanics. | **Do not accept the label**: AUD 330,000 of related obligations may be avoidable or attributable to Seller’s period. |
| **SPA-N-014 Category separation** | Limitations, exclusive remedy and non-reliance apply to **all Claims of any nature**. | Define distinct regimes for general warranties, fundamental/title, tax, specific indemnities, covenants, debt/price adjustments and fraud; state which limitations apply to each. | **Rewrite the hierarchy**: an “all Claims” clause could nullify negotiated special protections. |
| **SPA-N-015 Title verification** | DD-012 share register records Seller as holder of 100%. | Verify issued capital, ownership, transfer restrictions, options and encumbrances against corporate records and obtain executed transfers, certificates (if any), approvals and releases at Completion. | **Verify independently**: a register entry alone does not establish clean, deliverable title. |
| **SPA-N-016 Tax/IP open terms** | Tax and IP warranties said to be settled under the general regime. | Separate robust tax covenant/indemnity with a period tied to applicable assessment limits, and substantive IP ownership, assignment, sufficiency and non-infringement warranties with appropriate separate protection. | **Keep open**: tax exposure and core SaaS IP risk should not default to a 20%, 18-month general regime. |

**Priority for the next mark-up:** make Bluefen consent and Riverlark discharge Completion conditions; correct the bonuses and debt-free/cash-free funds flow; secure Ironquay IP title; and replace the blanket disclosure and “all Claims” limitation wording.
=== END ADVICE ===
